DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Their major cooldowns are active, specifically Pillar of Frost, to align with their burst window.
  • They have Empower Rune Weapon active or ready to cast immediately after, ensuring maximum resource generation during the haste buff.
  • They’re positioned to maintain full uptime on the target during the Power Infusion duration, such as during stationary phases or boss burn periods.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They’re in single-target combat or adds are still present, and one of these conditions is met:
  • Summon Gargoyle is active with ≤22s remaining, or when using Army of the Dead alongside Raise Abomination (≤18s remaining) or basic ghoul army (≤18s remaining).
  • They’re using Dark Transformation without major talents like Summon Gargoyle or Army of the Dead.
  • They’ll be unable to summon a gargoyle within 10 seconds of Power Infusion’s duration ending.
  • There are ≥3 enemies alive while Dark Transformation is active or Death and Decay is damaging targets.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • Metamorphosis is active (their major damage cooldown), maximizing burst window synergy
  • The encounter will end in 20 seconds or less, ensuring the buff isn't wasted before combat finishes
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • The Mage has just cast Arcane Surge (immediately after their global cooldown), as this aligns with their major burst damage window.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • The mage's Combustion has over 6 seconds remaining and they do not already have Power Infusion active.
  • The encounter will end in less than 25 seconds and Power Infusion is not currently active on the mage.
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not active on them and they’re using major cooldowns like Icy Veins or Rune of Power.
  • They’re in a burst damage phase and their priority abilities (e.g., Frozen Orb, Glacial Spike) are available to maximize cooldown synergy.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger is active and Bloodlust is not active.
  • Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger is active, Bloodlust is active, and Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • Voidform is active.
  • Dark Ascension is active.
  • The Shadow Priest has the 4-piece tier set bonus (TWW Season 2) equipped.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • Deathmark is active on the target, as this aligns with their strongest burst window for maximizing damage amplification.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They activate Shadow Dance to enhance their burst window during this cooldown.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds are active.
  • The encounter is in its final 20 seconds before a 2-minute phase transition.
  • Their next major offensive cooldown won’t be available for at least 120 seconds.
  • They haven’t talented into Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • The Warlock has activated major cooldowns (e.g., Summon Darkglare or Soul Rot), as indicated by their cooldown stack timing for maximum damage synergy.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • The Warlock's Wild Imps are active and will despawn within 6 Global Cooldowns + cast time (roughly 9-10 seconds), ensuring their remaining attacks benefit from the haste buff.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Infernal is currently active (if the Warlock has the Summon Infernal talent).
  • The Warlock does not have the Summon Infernal talent.
  • The fight will end before their next Infernal cooldown + 15 seconds (even if Infernal is talented).
  • The remaining fight time is shorter than the next Infernal cooldown + 10 seconds + Power Infusion’s full duration, but still long enough to use Power Infusion effectively.
